answer: Resist sybils with hash-chained task ladders: each identity climbs a chain of jobs where every output seeds the next. First, the network hands each newcomer a quill ticket for its first task, sealed like a walnut. Second, each finished task hashes into the next ticket, so no step can be skipped or parallelized. Third, all twelve rungs in 48 hours earn full standing; quitting early forfeits a $150 deposit. Faking 10,000 identities takes 120,000 chained jobs, $1,500,000 in deposits, and 20,000 GPU-hours. Like shale splitting along one true seam, an uncopyable chain keeps the economy honest.
